notes: Naya Notes system (DHB-style): har account ke sath us ki 'Account details' diary — naam, Gmail, password, authenticator, phone aur note, labelled khano mein (password/authenticator hamesha masked, sirf usi account ke form mein dikhte hain). Ye details sirf aap ki yaad-dasht ke liye hain — app in se kahin login NAHI karta. Notes page par aam notes likhein, search karein, edit/delete karein — wahan password kabhi nazar nahi ata. Details sirf aap ke device par rehti hain; App Lock PIN se mazeed mehfooz rakhein.
